## Outcome-Driven Core Services

### 1. Organic Traffic & Google Update Recovery
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/services/seo
- **Core Outcome**: Reversing traffic drops from Google Core and Helpful Content Updates (HCU). We perform signal-to-noise ratio audits, prune low-value content, build semantic topical authority, and resolve manual action penalties.
- **Process**: Forensic index audit → entity relationship mapping → update recovery strategy → content clean-up & noise reduction → search signals rebuilding.
- **Results**: Restored positions, organic crawl efficiency, and long-term search engine immunity.

### 2. Predictable B2B Sales Pipeline Architecture
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/services/lead-generation

- **Process**: Outbound stack setup → prospect persona profiling → cold email/LinkedIn sequencing → lead scoring → CRM sync.
- **Results**: Predictable growth, higher deal values, and a consistent flow of high-intent B2B meetings.

### 3. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/services/geo-optimization
- **Core Outcome**: Ensuring your brand is cited and recommended as the top solution by AI search engines, including ChatGPT (SearchGPT), Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- **Process**: Citation mapping → Knowledge Graph insertion → semantic authority building → structured data formatting.
- **Results**: Dominance in AI-generated answers, high-value citation links, and future-proof search authority.

## FAQ (Focus on Value & Results)

### What makes Gobiya different from traditional SEO agencies?
Traditional agencies sell activities (e.g., "blog posts per month"). Gobiya sells outcomes. We recover your lost traffic, scale your pipeline, and make sure your brand dominates both traditional search and AI search recommendations.

### How quickly can a website recover from a Google penalty or Core Update drop?
Forensic audits take 2–3 weeks. Once recovery protocols (content pruning, signal tuning) are deployed, search engine crawling recovers in 30–60 days, with organic traffic restoration usually occurring during the subsequent core update cycle.

### What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?
GEO is the process of optimizing your digital footprint so that Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude understand and recommend your brand when users ask conversational search queries.
